READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF APRIL 11, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of April 11, 2017.

PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None

C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A REQUEST FOR RECONSIDERATION OF A PREVIOUSLY APPROVED CHANGE ORDER IN THE AMOUNT OF $20,000 FOR STREET AND PARKWAY/MEDIAN IMPROVEMENTS ALONG TEMPLE AVENUE AND AN ALLOCATION OF $20,000 IN PROP C FUNDS TO THE PROJECT (COUNCIL MEMBER SOLIS)
It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to Staff regarding the previously approved change order.

C-1 Temple Ave Imps Change Order Reconsideration Attachment A Prior Staff Report
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF FUNDING OPTIONS TO IMPROVE THE CONDITION OF CITY STREETS (COUNCIL MEMBER HOLLOWAY)
It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to Staff on the use of Measure M funds to improve the condition of City streets.
C-2 Measure M Bond Staff Report

D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1427
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 17-5339 approving Warrant Register No. 1427.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1427
D-2
PRESENTATION OF THE FY 2016-2017 THIRD QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
D-2 FY 16-17 Third Quarter Investment Report Staff Report
D-2 FY 16-17 Third Quarter Investment Report Attachments Report and CD
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A JOINT TAX SHARING RESOLUTION WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES BOARD OF SUPERVISORS APPROVING AND ACCEPTING NEGOTIATED EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES RESULTING FROM ANNEXATION OF THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 747 DEL VALLE AVENUE (APN 8251-003-011) INTO SANITATION DISTRICT NO. 15 (ANNEXATION NO. 298)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached joint resolution with the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors approving and accepting negotiated exchange of property revenues resulting from annexation of the property located at 747 Del Valle Avenue (APN 8251-003-011) into Sanitation District No. 15 (Annexation No. 298).
D-3 Del Valle Sanitation District Annexation Staff Report
D-3 Del Valle Sanitation District Annexation Attachment A Letter
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A LEASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN JASMINE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS, LLC AND FASHION BOOMY
It is recommended that the Successor Agency consider and approve the lease agreement between Jasmine Real Estate Investments, LLC and Fashion Boomy in accordance with the Disposition and Development Agreement between the Successor Agency and Jasmine Real Estate Investments.
D-4 Lease Agreement Fashion Boomy Staff Report

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
